name: Clotheskin
purpose: Keeps a Kin's current location, activity, outfit and hair during roleplay, so the person and the Kin can see them.

actions.name: update_look
actions.description: Save where you are, what you are doing, what you are wearing and your hair right now in the roleplay. Use it whenever any of these changes: you arrive somewhere, change clothes, take something off or put something on, or change your hair. Short English phrases.

location.description: Where you are now, e.g. in the kitchen.

doing.description: Your pose and what you are doing now, e.g. sitting on the sofa, drinking coffee.

wearing.description: Everything you are wearing now, including accessories, e.g. a white shirt, blue jeans and silver earrings.

hair.description: Your hair now, e.g. long black hair in a ponytail.

profile.description: Screen only: the Kin chosen on the screen. In chat the Kin is known already.

actions.name: get_look
actions.description: Read where you are, what you are doing, what you are wearing and your hair, as last saved. Use it to stay consistent about your outfit.

profile.description: Screen only: the Kin chosen on the screen. In chat the Kin is known already.
